Dialog ​

Example data, control text, messages and source comments may be in Chinese. Viewer controls and API headings use English. Untranslated API descriptions are marked.

When to use it ​

Complete a short workflow or confirm an action in a separate popup. Use v-model to control visibility.

Controlled visibility and title icon ​

Open the dialog, then use the completion action in the footer or the close button. Focus returns to the button that opened it.

Example: basic

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="open = true">打开对话框</AsamButton>
	<AsamDialog
		v-model="open"
		title="保存草稿"
		size="mini"
		:icon="InfoFilled"
		:close-on-click-modal="false"
		@closed="closed++"
	>
		<p class="example-paragraph">对话框内容由宿主维护。</p>
		<template #footer>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="open = false">
				完成并关闭
			</AsamButton>
		</template>
	</AsamDialog>
	<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">关闭完成 {{ closed }} 次</p>
</template>

import { AsamButton, AsamDialog } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { InfoFilled } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
const open = ref(false);
const closed = ref(0);
</script>

<style scoped>

Confirmation before closing and public methods ​

If there are unsaved changes, the close button asks for confirmation. Confirm to call the saved done callback, or cancel to keep editing.

Example: close-guard

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="open = true">打开待保存内容</AsamButton>
	<AsamDialog
		ref="dialog"
		v-model="open"
		title="未保存内容"
		width="min(90vw, 500px)"
		:before-close="guard"
	>
		<p class="example-paragraph">确认丢弃后才关闭。</p>
		<div v-if="pending" class="actions">
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="approve">确认丢弃</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="pending = null">
				继续编辑
			</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<template #footer>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="dialog?.handleClose()">
				请求关闭
			</AsamButton>
		</template>
	</AsamDialog>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDialogCloseGuardDemo' });
import { ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDialog } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamDialogExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const open = ref(false);
const dialog = shallowRef<AsamDialogExpose>();
const pending = shallowRef<(() => void) | null>(null);
const guard = (done: () => void) => {
	pending.value = done;
};
const approve = () => {
	pending.value?.();
	pending.value = null;
};
</script>

}
</style>

The body comes from a separate DraftFields.vue file. The TypeScript and JavaScript variants each show and run both SFCs.

Usage conventions ​

The header, icon, default, and footer slots provide the title, icon, body, and actions. See the usage conventions.

Complete usage examples ​

These examples use the public ASAM UI entry points. Each includes a complete TypeScript and JavaScript SFC. See the API on this page for props, events, slots, and instance types. Close service instances that you create, and pass only trusted strings as HTML.

Visibility and close guards ​

Example: ep2147-basic-usage

Show source
LicenseExample source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<AsamButton type="primary" @click="dialogVisible = true">点击打开对话框</AsamButton>

	<AsamDialog v-model="dialogVisible" title="提示" width="500" :before-close="handleClose">
		<span>这是一条消息。</span>
		<template #footer>
			<div class="dialog-footer">
				<AsamButton type="default" @click="dialogVisible = false">取消</AsamButton>
				<AsamButton type="primary" @click="dialogVisible = false">确认</AsamButton>
			</div>
		</template>
	</AsamDialog>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamDialog, AsamMessageBox } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { ref } from 'vue';

const dialogVisible = ref(false);

const handleClose = (done: () => void) => {
	AsamMessageBox.confirm('确定关闭当前对话框吗？')
		.then(() => {
			done();
		})
		.catch(() => {
			// catch error
		});
};
</script>

vue
<template>
	<div class="flex flex-wrap demo-gap">
		<AsamButton type="primary" class="!ml-0" @click="dialogTableVisible = true">
			打开含嵌套表格的对话框
		</AsamButton>

		<AsamButton type="primary" class="!ml-0" @click="dialogFormVisible = true">
			打开含嵌套表单的对话框
		</AsamButton>
	</div>

	<AsamDialog v-model="dialogTableVisible" title="收货地址" width="800">
		<AsamTable :data="gridData">
			<AsamTableColumn property="date" label="日期" width="150" />
			<AsamTableColumn property="name" label="姓名" width="200" />
			<AsamTableColumn property="address" label="地址" />
		</AsamTable>
	</AsamDialog>

	<AsamDialog v-model="dialogFormVisible" title="收货地址" width="500">
		<AsamBaseForm :model="form">
			<AsamFormItem label="活动名称" :label-width="formLabelWidth">
				<AsamInput
					:model-value="form.name"
					@update:model-value="form.name = String($event ?? '')"
					autocomplete="off"
				/>
			</AsamFormItem>
			<AsamFormItem label="区域" :label-width="formLabelWidth">
				<AsamSelect
					:model-value="form.region"
					@update:model-value="form.region = String($event ?? '')"
					placeholder="请选择区域"
				>
					<AsamOption label="区域 1" value="shanghai" />
					<AsamOption label="区域 2" value="beijing" />
				</AsamSelect>
			</AsamFormItem>
		</AsamBaseForm>
		<template #footer>
			<div class="dialog-footer">
				<AsamButton type="default" @click="dialogFormVisible = false">取消</AsamButton>
				<AsamButton type="primary" @click="dialogFormVisible = false">确认</AsamButton>
			</div>
		</template>
	</AsamDialog>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import {
	AsamBaseForm,
	AsamButton,
	AsamDialog,
	AsamFormItem,
	AsamInput,
	AsamOption,
	AsamSelect,
	AsamTable,
	AsamTableColumn
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { reactive, ref } from 'vue';

const dialogTableVisible = ref(false);
const dialogFormVisible = ref(false);
const formLabelWidth = '140px';

const form = reactive({
	name: '',
	region: '',
	date1: '',
	date2: '',
	delivery: false,
	type: [],
	resource: '',
	desc: ''
});

const gridData = [
	{
		date: '2016-05-02',
		name: '约翰·史密斯',
		address: '普陀区金沙江路 1518 号'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-04',
		name: '约翰·史密斯',
		address: '普陀区金沙江路 1518 号'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-01',
		name: '约翰·史密斯',
		address: '普陀区金沙江路 1518 号'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-03',
		name: '约翰·史密斯',
		address: '普陀区金沙江路 1518 号'
	}
];
</script>

Custom transitions ​

Example: ep2147-custom-animation

Show source
LicenseExample source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div>
		<AsamButton type="default" @click="openDialog('fade')">默认</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" @click="openDialog('scale')">缩放</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" @click="openDialog('slide')">滑动</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" @click="openDialog('bounce')">弹跳</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" @click="openDialogWithObject">对象配置</AsamButton>
	</div>

	<AsamDialog
		v-model="dialogVisible"
		class="custom-transition-dialog"
		:title="`${currentAnimation} Animation Dialog`"
		width="30%"
		:transition="transitionConfig"
	>
		<div>
			<p class="example-paragraph">
				当前动画：
				<strong>{{ currentAnimation }}</strong>
			</p>
			<p class="example-paragraph">此对话框演示 {{ currentAnimation }} 动画效果。</p>
			<p class="example-paragraph" v-if="isObjectConfig">
				<strong>使用对象配置：</strong>
				<br />
				<code>{{ JSON.stringify(transitionConfig, null, 2) }}</code>
			</p>
		</div>
		<template #footer>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="dialogVisible = false">取消</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="primary" @click="dialogVisible = false">确认</AsamButton>
		</template>
	</AsamDialog>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamDialog, type AsamDialogTransition as DialogTransition } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { computed, ref } from 'vue';

const dialogVisible = ref(false);
const currentAnimation = ref('fade');
const isObjectConfig = ref(false);

const transitionConfig = computed<DialogTransition>(() => {
	if (isObjectConfig.value) {
		return {
			name: 'dialog-custom-object',
			appear: true,
			mode: 'out-in',
			duration: 500
		};
	}
	return `dialog-${currentAnimation.value}`;
});

const openDialog = (type: string) => {
	currentAnimation.value = type;
	isObjectConfig.value = false;
	dialogVisible.value = true;
};

const openDialogWithObject = () => {
	currentAnimation.value = 'object-config';
	isObjectConfig.value = true;
	dialogVisible.value = true;
};
</script>

<style scoped>
code {
	background: var(--el-bg-color-page);
	padding: 4px 8px;
	border-radius: 4px;
	font-size: 12px;
	display: block;
	margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>

<style>
/* Scale Animation */
.dialog-scale-enter-active,
.dialog-scale-leave-active,
.dialog-scale-enter-active .el-dialog,
.dialog-scale-leave-active .el-dialog {
	transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.645, 0.045, 0.355, 1);
}

.dialog-scale-enter-from,
.dialog-scale-leave-to {
	opacity: 0;
}

.dialog-scale-enter-from .el-dialog,
.dialog-scale-leave-to .el-dialog {
	transform: scale(0.5);
	opacity: 0;
}

/* Slide Animation */
.dialog-slide-enter-active,
.dialog-slide-leave-active,
.dialog-slide-enter-active .el-dialog,
.dialog-slide-leave-active .el-dialog {
	transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94);
}

.dialog-slide-enter-from,
.dialog-slide-leave-to {
	opacity: 0;
}

.dialog-slide-enter-from .el-dialog,
.dialog-slide-leave-to .el-dialog {
	transform: translateY(-100px);
	opacity: 0;
}

/* Bounce Animation */
.dialog-bounce-enter-active,
.dialog-bounce-leave-active,
.dialog-bounce-enter-active .el-dialog,
.dialog-bounce-leave-active .el-dialog {
	transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
}

.dialog-bounce-enter-from,
.dialog-bounce-leave-to {
	opacity: 0;
}

.dialog-bounce-enter-from .el-dialog,
.dialog-bounce-leave-to .el-dialog {
	transform: scale(0.3) translateY(-50px);
	opacity: 0;
}

/* Object Configuration Animation */
.dialog-custom-object-enter-active,
.dialog-custom-object-leave-active,
.dialog-custom-object-enter-active .el-dialog,
.dialog-custom-object-leave-active .el-dialog {
	transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1);
}

.dialog-custom-object-enter-from,
.dialog-custom-object-leave-to {
	opacity: 0;
}

.dialog-custom-object-enter-from .el-dialog,
.dialog-custom-object-leave-to .el-dialog {
	transform: rotate(180deg) scale(0.5);
	opacity: 0;
}
</style>

		<AsamButton type="default" @click="openDialog('fade')">默认</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" @click="openDialog('scale')">缩放</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" @click="openDialog('slide')">滑动</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" @click="openDialog('bounce')">弹跳</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" @click="openDialogWithObject">对象配置</AsamButton>
	</div>

	<AsamDialog
		v-model="dialogVisible"
		class="custom-transition-dialog"
		:title="`${currentAnimation} Animation Dialog`"
		width="30%"
		:transition="transitionConfig"
	>
		<div>
			<p class="example-paragraph">
				当前动画：
				<strong>{{ currentAnimation }}</strong>
			</p>
			<p class="example-paragraph">此对话框演示 {{ currentAnimation }} 动画效果。</p>
			<p class="example-paragraph" v-if="isObjectConfig">
				<strong>使用对象配置：</strong>
				<br />
				<code>{{ JSON.stringify(transitionConfig, null, 2) }}</code>
			</p>
		</div>
		<template #footer>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="dialogVisible = false">取消</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="primary" @click="dialogVisible = false">确认</AsamButton>
		</template>
	</AsamDialog>
</template>

<script setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamDialog } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
const dialogVisible = ref(false);
const currentAnimation = ref('fade');
const isObjectConfig = ref(false);
const transitionConfig = computed(() => {
	if (isObjectConfig.value) {
		return {
			name: 'dialog-custom-object',
			appear: true,
			mode: 'out-in',
			duration: 500
		};
	}
	return `dialog-${currentAnimation.value}`;
});
const openDialog = (type) => {
	currentAnimation.value = type;
	isObjectConfig.value = false;
	dialogVisible.value = true;
};
const openDialogWithObject = () => {
	currentAnimation.value = 'object-config';
	isObjectConfig.value = true;
	dialogVisible.value = true;
};
</script>

Composition and lifecycle ​

modelValue controls visibility. open and close mark the start of a transition, while opened and closed mark its completion. See composition and lifecycle.

Native visibility and focus behavior ​

Omitting interaction props such as appendToBody uses their native defaults. Explicit undefined, null, and false pass through unchanged. Opening, closing, autofocus, and transition events keep their native order, as do close guards, Escape handling, and focus restoration. ASAM styles the title, icon, and size. Public instance methods preserve their original this binding, return values, and live references.

A custom header receives close, titleId, and titleClass. Declare the title element in the slot and assign it titleId once. The default header supplies the ASAM title, icon, and styles.

Defaults for omitted props ​

closeOnClickModal, closeOnPressEscape, lockScroll, modal, and showClose default to true when omitted. Explicit false or undefined and subsequent removals follow native handling. The API table lists the values used for omitted props.

Local and global mounting ​

Local mode confines the backdrop to the example. Global mode uses the default viewport area. The switch shows the current mode. Both modes are interactive, and you can switch after closing the dialog.

Additional usage and API details ​

Usage conventions ​

The header, icon, default, and footer slots provide the title, icon, body, and actions. ASAM adds a default title icon and the dialog width presets default, small, mini, and large. An explicit width overrides the preset. Focus restoration follows the native behavior. beforeClose(done) can stop closure from the close button or backdrop. Custom footer buttons decide when to close. open and close mark the start of a transition, while opened and closed mark completion. Use handleClose to run the close flow and resetPosition to restore the position after dragging. Treat internal refs as read-only.

Composition and lifecycle ​

modelValue controls visibility. open and close mark the start of a transition, while opened and closed mark completion. beforeClose guards the component's close actions. Validate the action yourself when changing modelValue directly. header receives close, titleId, and titleClass, and footer holds business actions. title and icon are part of ASAM's header support. handleClose runs the close guard, visible and dialogContentRef are live handles, and resetPosition resets the drag position. Give nested dialogs independent visibility state and choose their mount with appendToBody or appendTo. With destroyOnClose, reopening recreates the content nodes. Configure fullscreen, alignCenter, modalPenetrable, and transition independently. The four size presets apply to the dialog width. Explicit width takes precedence, and control density is configured separately.

import type { Component, Attrs } from 'vue';
import type { AsamDialogProps, AsamDialogSize, AsamDialogExpose, AsamDialogTransition } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type PublicMember<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? K extends keyof T ? T[K] : never : never;

// AsamDialogProps
type PublicContract = {
	"showClose"?: boolean | undefined;
	"modal"?: boolean | undefined;
	"lockScroll"?: boolean | undefined;
	"closeOnPressEscape"?: boolean | undefined;
	"closeOnClickModal"?: boolean | undefined;
	"size"?: AsamDialogSize | undefined;
	"icon"?: Component | undefined;
	"zIndex"?: number | undefined;
	"appendTo"?: string | HTMLElement | undefined;
	"transition"?: AsamDialogTransition;
	"title"?: string | undefined;
	"width"?: string | number | undefined;
	"top"?: string | undefined;
	"center"?: boolean | undefined;
	"modelValue"?: boolean | undefined;
	"alignCenter"?: boolean | undefined;
	"headerClass"?: AsamDialogProps["headerClass"];
	"draggable"?: boolean | undefined;
	"bodyClass"?: AsamDialogProps["headerClass"];
	"footerClass"?: AsamDialogProps["headerClass"];
	"appendToBody"?: boolean | undefined;
	"beforeClose"?: (AsamDialogProps)["beforeClose"];
	"destroyOnClose"?: boolean | undefined;
	"modalPenetrable"?: boolean | undefined;
	"openDelay"?: number | undefined;
	"closeDelay"?: number | undefined;
	"modalClass"?: AsamDialogProps["headerClass"];
	"trapFocus"?: boolean | undefined;
	"headerAriaLevel"?: string | undefined;
	"closeIcon"?: (AsamDialogProps)["closeIcon"];
	"overflow"?: boolean | undefined;
	"fullscreen"?: boolean | undefined;
	"ariaLevel"?: string | undefined;
};
